title: Mating with king and queen
summary: Push the king to the edge, then finish it.

steps.text: With king and queen against a lone king you can always win. Use the queen to box the enemy king in, a knight's move away from it, and shrink the box until the king is on the edge. Then bring your own king close and deliver mate. Careful: if the enemy king has no moves and is not in check, it is stalemate.

steps.hint: Your king already covers g7 and h7.
steps.success: Checkmate. Your king protects the queen and controls the escape squares.
